svg.title: Apprise Overview
svg.desc: How Apprise fits together. On the left, the sources that send notifications: Apprise Mobile, HTTP and webhook clients, the Apprise API, the Apprise CLI, and Apprise-aware software. In the middle, the two entry points: the Apprise API server and the Apprise core library. On the right, the destinations they deliver to, including Discord, Telegram, Email, Slack, Gotify, ntfy, Microsoft Teams, Pushover, Home Assistant, WhatsApp, Matrix and Signal, out of more than 150 supported services.
